name: elevate-seller
description: Analyse Amazon products for sourcing with the seller's Elevate Seller grid, then record the opinion in the application. Includes the product analysis skill and the Elevate Seller MCP server.

api_key.title: Elevate Seller API key
api_key.description: An API key of your organisation, created in Elevate Seller under Settings › API keys. A read-write key is needed to record opinions.
